Treatment summary
Patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot with complaints of neck pain, restricted cervical range of
motion, and muscle tension. The reported mechanism of injury is conssitent with the nature and force of the impact. Over the
course of 17 visits, care consisted of conservative management including manual therapy, therapeutic exercise, and home
stretching instructions. Treatment followed a typical and expected progression, with visit frequency reduced as symptoms
steadily improved and range of motion returned toward normal. Imaging and physical examination findings clearly corroborate
the diagnosis of cervical strain. The patient reports no konwn prior injury or treatment involving the cervical spine. Billed
services reflect the treatment rendered, with no repeated or duplicate charges identified. Patient was discharged to self-directed
home exercise with instructions to return if symptoms recur.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
